author: kirubaharan181
description: Use when automating delivery: CI/CD, containers, infrastructure as code, environments. Do NOT use for release approval or runtime ops.
purpose: Automates secure, repeatable delivery: CI and CD pipelines, builds and artifacts, containers and orchestration, infrastructure as code, configuration, environment provisioning and deployment automation. It owns stages 111-125.
when_to_use: A pipeline, build or deployment automation is needed or fails.
Containers, orchestration or infrastructure as code must be defined.
prerequisites: A secrets store for pipeline credentials.
No external API keys, paid services or network access are required; work uses files and tools already approved in the repository.
outputs: reproducible environments and pipeline run records

decision_rules.action: Use short-lived federated credentials where possible.

decision_rules.situation: Untrusted pull request triggers a privileged job
decision_rules.action: Separate the trust levels; deny secrets to untrusted code.
Detect drift and reapply from code.
Require the approval recorded under release-deployment.

examples.title: Create a CI pipeline
examples.request: Add CI for the notifications service.
examples.context: Python, tests take 4 minutes, protected main.
examples.behavior: Define build, lint, test and scan jobs with pinned versions and read-only token permissions.
examples.output: Pipeline file, a run record and the required-check setting.
examples.acceptance: Pull requests cannot merge without the checks.

examples.title: Harden a pull-request workflow
examples.request: Fork pull requests run with secrets.
examples.behavior: Split into an untrusted test job without secrets and a trusted release job, then test with a fork.
examples.output: Workflow change and a negative test showing the fork cannot read secrets.

limitations: Cannot verify pipelines against platforms it cannot reach.
Pipeline results depend on runner images and versions.

troubleshooting.error: Build works locally but fails in CI

troubleshooting.resolution: Measure stages, cache safely and parallelize.
Rotate, mask and add a log scan.

handoffs.artifact: deployable artifacts and pipeline run records
